name: Lekato PD705 (DrumPad)
source: The factory note map of pd705-rs pd705-midi DEFAULT_MAP (FORMAT.md section 4), channel 10, the same table as djengine::gear::PD705_NOTES. The pad's USB name is DrumPad (VID 35ba, PID 1101). Written 2026-11-07 for the binding map. Nothing is bound by default: the hub plays this pad, and a hit by hand should not start a deck until you say so.

groups.comment: Pad 1-9 (3x3), the factory kit's note numbers
the four trigger inputs on the back
the two foot inputs (hat pedal, kick pedal)
